darkcraft.nueva.normal: Hard but fair: the way it's meant to be played.
darkcraft.nueva.dificil: Enemies hit half again as hard.
darkcraft.clase.subtitulo: Who you were before the Shadow brought you back to life
darkcraft.clase.caballero.desc: A lordless knight in heavy armour. Sword, shield and a body that can take a beating.
darkcraft.clase.vagabundo.desc: A wanderer of the roads: nimble, with sword and bow. Fights fast, and from afar when needed.
darkcraft.clase.barbaro.desc: Brute strength and an axe that splits shields. Little finesse, a lot of hitting.
darkcraft.clase.guerrero.desc: A sword in each hand and light feet. Dexterity is their strength.
darkcraft.clase.bandido.desc: Lives off the shadows: dagger, bow and luck on their side (arcane).
darkcraft.clase.hechicero.desc: Studied the Shadow's forbidden sorceries. A staff, three spells and little armour.
darkcraft.clase.profeta.desc: Speaks with what lies beyond. Sacred seal, miracles of healing and fire, and a spear.
darkcraft.clase.confesor.desc: A knight of the faith: sword and shield, and miracles to heal and bless the blade.
darkcraft.clase.prisionero.desc: Escaped with the cage still on their head. Sword and sorceries: clever and quick.
darkcraft.clase.desdichado.desc: Has nothing: no armour, no trade. Everything at 10. For those who would make themselves.
advancements.darkcraft.clase.title: Marked by the Shadow
advancements.darkcraft.clase.description: Choose who you were before you awoke
darkcraft.diario.clase: I awoke without knowing how. I should be dead. I know who I was, and that will have to be enough.
darkcraft.cartel.pieza: Piece of the Grey Heron · %s of %s
darkcraft.pueblo.lapida.pescador: Hobb the Fisherman. The clouds took him in the year 187.
darkcraft.pueblo.lapida.tejedora: Edda the Weaver. She fell asleep at her loom in the year 198.
darkcraft.pueblo.lapida.farero: Aldric the Keeper. He put out his light in the year 212.
darkcraft.pueblo.faltan.1: The Grey Heron is still missing one piece.
darkcraft.pueblo.faltan.2: The Grey Heron is still missing two pieces.
darkcraft.pueblo.faltan.3: The Grey Heron is still missing three pieces.
darkcraft.pueblo.faltan.4: The Grey Heron is still missing four pieces.
darkcraft.pueblo.faltan.5: The Grey Heron is missing her sail, helm, mast, anchor and heart.
darkcraft.pueblo.campanas.mal: The bells fall silent. That was not the order.
darkcraft.pueblo.cripta: In the chapel, a slab slides aside.
darkcraft.pueblo.sin_rumbo: The Grey Heron cannot find a heading.
darkcraft.pueblo.llegada: The Grey Heron leaves you at the foot of the Tower of Ascent.
darkcraft.pueblo.no_aqui: There is no Brumavela here (a cloud world is needed).
darkcraft.ayuda.b_ir: go to a place on the island (no name: where you wake up)
darkcraft.ayuda.b_piezas: give ship pieces / open the crypt / repair the ship (with "ya", no cinematic)
darkcraft.ayuda.b_estado: see how it stands / put everything back as it was
advancements.darkcraft.brumavela.title: Castaway of the Clouds
advancements.darkcraft.pieza.title: Timber and Canvas
advancements.darkcraft.pieza.description: Find a piece of the Grey Heron
advancements.darkcraft.campanas.title: Three Bells
advancements.darkcraft.campanas.descript: Ring the bells in the order in which the founders died
advancements.darkcraft.piezas.title: The Five Pieces
advancements.darkcraft.piezas.descriptio: Gather the sail, the helm, the mast, the anchor and the heart
advancements.darkcraft.barco.title: The Grey Heron
advancements.darkcraft.zarpar.title: Bound for Valdrenn
advancements.darkcraft.zarpar.descriptio: Set sail for the Kingdom of Valdrenn
darkcraft.diario.brumavela: I woke on a quay, above a sea of clouds, beside a broken ship. There is no one. Only mist, and houses with their doors left open.
darkcraft.diario.pieza: I found a piece of the ship. Someone took her apart on purpose and scattered the pieces across the island.
darkcraft.diario.campanas: The Fisherman, the Weaver, the Keeper. Three bells, in the order of their gravestones, and the crypt opened.
darkcraft.diario.piezas: I have all five now. The Grey Heron is waiting at the quay.
darkcraft.diario.barco: The Grey Heron is whole again. Her heart beats in the hold and she strains at her moorings, upward.
darkcraft.diario.zarpar: I left Brumavela behind. Ahead, among the clouds, a vast island with a black castle: Valdrenn.
darkcraft.capitan.voz.1: No one sails from Brumavela. The light stays lit... until my crew comes home.
darkcraft.capitan.voz.2: All hands! Up from the deep! All hands on deck!
darkcraft.capitan.voz.3: Down you go... with the rest of them.
darkcraft.capitan.voz.4: The heart is not yours to take!
darkcraft.capitan.voz.5: Take it, then... and take us... with you.
darkcraft.pueblo.timon_guardado: The ones in the tavern will not let you take it.
darkcraft.pueblo.reja: The grate will not give. Whoever locked it still stands.
darkcraft.pueblo.frasco: Among what he leaves, one more flask.
darkcraft.ayuda.b_enemigos: see the island's enemies / bring them all back / remove them
darkcraft.ayuda.b_capitan: go before the Captain / mark him defeated / put him back at his door
darkcraft.bestiario.hueco_horca.desc: What is left of the people of Brumavela. The pitchfork reaches far, but the thrust is easy to read: step aside and punish.
darkcraft.bestiario.hueco_hoz.desc: Quick and close: two slashes in a row. Step back and move in when the second one misses.
darkcraft.bestiario.hueco_antorcha.desc: Its blows set you alight. Do not let it corner you: its sweep covers everything in front of it.
darkcraft.bestiario.ahogado_sable.desc: The crew of the Grey Heron, given back by the sea of clouds. Slow and heavy: the slashes hurt, but he takes his time to recover.
darkcraft.bestiario.ahogado_arpon.desc: Throws his harpoon from afar: he aims for a moment before letting go, so move sideways. Up close, he stabs.
darkcraft.bestiario.capitan.desc: Edrik Maroll, captain of the Grey Heron. He took his ship apart so no one would carry the mist to another island, and carried the heart up to the lighthouse so his drowned could find the way back. They did.
advancements.darkcraft.hueco.title: No Longer Themselves
advancements.darkcraft.hueco.description: Defeat one of those who remain in Brumavela
advancements.darkcraft.capitan.title: The Last Captain
darkcraft.diario.hueco: The houses are not empty. The people are still here, but there is no one behind their eyes. I had to defend myself.
darkcraft.diario.capitan: The Captain was guarding the door of his lighthouse. As he fell he told me to take it, and to take them with it. The grate opened by itself.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.2: No name... No grave... Only the dark.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.3: But I reached in... and I cast you back.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.4: You carry my mark now. Death will not keep you... not while I need you.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.5: There is a door I cannot open. You will open it for me.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.7: There... Valdrenn. The kingdom that begged for my gift.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.8: Its king and his knight still keep their oaths... chains around my throat.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.9: Break them, marked one... and I will show you the door.
darkcraft.ayuda.b_inicio: watch the opening cinematic again (the Shadow, the fall and the awakening)
darkcraft.pueblo.campana.roto: The bell rings out over the clouds. Nothing answers.
darkcraft.pueblo.campana.aqui: The Grey Heron is already moored here.
darkcraft.pueblo.campana.viene: The Grey Heron is already on her way.
darkcraft.ayuda.b_barco: set sail from the helm (with "primero", the first-voyage cinematic) / call the ship / go to Valdrenn Quay / put the ship at a quay
darkcraft.bestiario.arquero.desc: The King's archers still stand on the walls and the tower tops. They draw slowly: when the string reaches the chin, step aside or roll. Up close, on their wall, they cannot last.
darkcraft.ayuda.v_enemigos: the enemies of this kingdom: how many are left, spawn them or mark them as fallen; its ambushes (trigger or re-arm them)
darkcraft.bestiario.perro.desc: The guard's hounds kept hunting long after their flesh was gone. They run in packs: the first to see you howls and the rest come. They crouch before they leap: roll aside.
darkcraft.bestiario.espectro_cortesano.d: A noble of King Corvin who never left the castle. His rapier reaches further than it seems; he fades away and appears behind you.
darkcraft.bestiario.espectro_dama.desc: A lady of the court who still wanders the halls. Her touch leaves you cold, and when she throws her head back the wail is coming: get away before she screams.
darkcraft.bestiario.espectro_vigia.desc: The watchmen of Velan's tower went up to look at the red sky and never came down. They haunt the Bone Fortress, hoods drawn and eyes burning: they fade out and reappear every few moments and, in a fight, always come back at your back.
darkcraft.bestiario.capitan_elite.desc: King Corvin's captains still command their men. When he sees you he raises his greatsword and roars: those who hear him come for you and hit harder. His overhead strike shakes the ground (jump or roll) and his charge crosses half a square. If he falls, the rest lose heart.
advancements.darkcraft.capitan_elite.des: Defeat a captain of the Valdrenn guard
advancements.darkcraft.emboscada.title: It Was a Trap
advancements.darkcraft.emboscada.descrip: Defeat everyone in an ambush in Valdrenn
darkcraft.diario.capitan_elite: The guard has captains. When theirs fell, the others faltered. I will remember that.
darkcraft.diario.emboscada: The dead of Valdrenn knew I was coming: they rose from the earth all around me. I am still alive.
darkcraft.bestiario.brandt.desc: In life he was King Corvin's shield; in death he is his wall. He guards the door of the throne hall behind an iron pavise that stops everything from the front. Circle him or strike while he attacks. If he plants himself behind the shield, don't hit it: he will hit back. His hammer shakes the ground and, when wounded, he leaps and splits it.
darkcraft.bestiario.corteza.desc: One of Ser Gavran's knights, who guarded the tree for so long that the tree kept him. His roots break the floor in a line and his bark spits thorns in a fan; when wounded, roots burst out all around him. Fire deals him double damage.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.brandt_escudo: A blow glances off the pavise
advancements.darkcraft.brandt.title: The Wall Has Fallen
advancements.darkcraft.brandt.descriptio: Defeat Ser Brandt, the King's Wall, before the throne hall
advancements.darkcraft.vareth.title: Uprooted
advancements.darkcraft.vareth.descriptio: Defeat Vareth, the Bark Warden, at the foot of the tree tower
darkcraft.diario.brandt: Ser Brandt guarded the King's door with a shield like a rampart. I had to wait for him to lower his guard. When he fell, the seal on the throne hall broke.
darkcraft.diario.vareth: At the foot of the tree waited Vareth, more root than man. He burned better than I expected. The way to Ser Gavran is open.
darkcraft.guardian.sello.brandt: A seal of shadow bars the throne hall. Ser Brandt guards it.
darkcraft.guardian.sello.corteza: A seal of shadow bars the way. Vareth guards it.
darkcraft.ayuda.v_guardian: the two guardians: how they stand, go before one, mark him defeated (his seal breaks) or bring him back
advancements.darkcraft.morvain.title: The Withered Lands
advancements.darkcraft.morvain.descripti: Cross the Shadow's portal and set foot in Morvain
darkcraft.diario.morvain: I crossed the portal. On the other side, a withered land beneath a sky that never quite grows dark... and high above, a castle held by chains.
item.darkcraft.silbato_corcel.desc: Carved bone from Maelis's sisters. Blow it in Morvain and the steed will come out of the mist.
darkcraft.corcel.como: Use the whistle or press the steed key (H) to call it
darkcraft.corcel.sin_silbato: You are not carrying the steed whistle
darkcraft.corcel.solo_morvain: Your whistle makes no sound here: the steed only comes in Morvain
darkcraft.corcel.espera: Your steed has not yet returned from the mist (%s s)
darkcraft.corcel.deshecho: Your steed has dissolved into the mist. It will return in %s s
darkcraft.corcel.sitio: There is no room for your steed here
darkcraft.corcel.agua: The steed will not tread deep water
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.11: So the door let you through... Welcome to Morvain, marked one. The Withered Lands. Everything here remembers the Shadow.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.12: These lands are vast... too vast for tired feet. Take this whistle. It was carved from the bones of my sisters' steed. Blow it, and it will come to you, out of the mist.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.13: It runs like the wind and leaps where no horse could. And if it falls... it returns to the mist for a while. But it always comes back.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.14: The fires of Morvain are few, and far apart. Rest while you can, marked one.
advancements.darkcraft.silbato.title: A Whistle of Bone
advancements.darkcraft.silbato.descripti: Receive the steed whistle from Maelis at the Threshold Arch
advancements.darkcraft.corcel.title: Steed of Bone and Mist
darkcraft.diario.silbato: Maelis gave me a whistle carved from bone. She says what answers its call comes out of the mist... and returns to it when it falls.
darkcraft.diario.corcel: I blew the whistle and the mist took shape: a horse of bone, its eyes burning blue. It gallops without tiring and leaps twice in the air.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.corcel_salto: The steed leaps through the mist
darkcraft.ayuda.corcel: the steed: call it, give yourself the whistle, send it away, hurt it or clear its wait
darkcraft.menu.santuario.viajar.desc: Travel to another sanctuary of Morvain where you have rested or that you have kindled.
advancements.darkcraft.viaje.title: From Fire to Fire
advancements.darkcraft.viaje.description: Travel between two sanctuaries of Morvain
darkcraft.diario.viaje: I rested by the fire and thought of another I had already kindled. When I opened my eyes, I was there. The sanctuaries of Morvain remember one another.
darkcraft.ayuda.viaje: travel between the sanctuaries of Morvain: the ones you know, mark them as known, forget them or take you to one
darkcraft.estela.ya: You already have the map of this region.
darkcraft.viaje.enemigos: You cannot travel with enemies nearby.
advancements.darkcraft.fragmento.title: The Map in the Stone
advancements.darkcraft.fragmento.descrip: Copy the map from a stele of Morvain
advancements.darkcraft.mapa_morvain.desc: Copy all nine map fragments of Morvain
darkcraft.diario.fragmento: Beside the fire stood a stele with the region's map carved into the stone and a parchment nailed to it. I copied it into the Shadow's book: now I know where I am.
darkcraft.diario.mapa_morvain: Nine steles, nine fragments. The map of Morvain is whole in my book... and every road leads to the chained castle.
darkcraft.bestiario.marchito_guadana.des: The people of Velmor, dried from within until only walking ash remains. The scythe sweeps everything in front of it: step back and move in when the sweep ends; its overhead cut is easy to read.
darkcraft.bestiario.marchito_farol.desc: Carries one of Velmor's street lanterns, still burning with soul fire. If it smashes it on the ground, the fire keeps burning for a moment: do not stand in it. Its blows set you alight.
darkcraft.bestiario.marchito_campana.des: The bell-ringer avoids a fight if it can: if it sees you from afar, it rings its bell and everyone nearby comes running. Go for it first, or stay out of its sight.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.marchito_farol: A lantern bursts into soul fire
advancements.darkcraft.marchito.title: Walking Ash
advancements.darkcraft.marchito.descript: Defeat a Withered of the Pale Plains
advancements.darkcraft.velmor.title: The Bells of Velmor
darkcraft.diario.marchito: Out on the plains the people did not die: they dried out. What is left of them is ash in the shape of a person, still gripping whatever they held.
darkcraft.diario.velmor: Velmor: a broken bridge, a roofless chapel and a bell tower that still has its bell. Its folk are still in the streets, the fields, the tavern... waiting.
darkcraft.ayuda.velmor: Velmor, the withered village: go to one of its places, bring its Withered back or remove them
darkcraft.molinera.voz.1: Who treads upon my wheat...? Nothing grows here anymore. Nothing... but me.
darkcraft.molinera.voz.2: Grind, wheel, grind! Come, children of Velmor... the harvest is here!
darkcraft.molinera.voz.3: Into the sack with you... like all the others.
darkcraft.molinera.voz.4: Round and round the millstone goes!
darkcraft.molinera.voz.5: The wheel... has stopped... at last.
darkcraft.bestiario.molinera.desc: Velmor's miller is still on her threshing floor, reaping what no longer grows, and the Shadow made her grow twice as tall. Her sweep skims the ground and covers almost everything in front of her: jump it or roll. Her overhead cut bites into the floor and sends out a shockwave. Whoever gets behind her is kicked away with a stomp. Wounded, she calls Velmor's Withered and spins with her scythe held wide.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.molinera_siega: A huge scythe sweeps the air
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.molinera_golpe: A scythe bites into the earth
advancements.darkcraft.molinera.title: The Wheel Has Stopped
advancements.darkcraft.molinera.descript: Defeat the Miller of Velmor on her mill's threshing floor
darkcraft.diario.molinera: On the threshing floor of the mill, east of Velmor, the miller was still kneeling before her stone. She rose twice as tall as anyone, with a scythe like a windmill sail. When she fell, the mill stopped creaking and its gate swung open.
darkcraft.ayuda.molinera: The Miller of Velmor: how she is, take you to the threshing floor, defeat her or bring her back
darkcraft.bestiario.ahorcado_garras.desc: They were hanged in the Grove and the Shadow would not let them die. They wait on their ropes, turning slowly, and drop onto whoever passes close: look up before walking under a branch. On the ground they are quick: a swipe, a double swipe and a leap from afar.
darkcraft.bestiario.ahorcado_soga.desc: It wears a sack over its head and carries the rope in its hand. Its lash reaches far and its noose even further: if it catches you, it drags you to its feet. Roll or raise your shield when it throws.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.ahorcado_cae: A Hanged One drops from its branch
advancements.darkcraft.ahorcado.title: Cut Down
advancements.darkcraft.ahorcado.descript: Defeat a Hanged One of the Dead Forest
advancements.darkcraft.arboleda.title: Beneath the Gallows Tree
advancements.darkcraft.arboleda.descript: Enter the Grove of the Hanged
darkcraft.diario.ahorcado: In the Dead Forest the trees bear a fruit no one eats. It hangs, turning slowly in the wind... and drops when you pass beneath.
darkcraft.diario.arboleda: The Grove of the Hanged: a huge tree full of ropes, a gallows with its trapdoor and the crosses of those who were cut down. Someone kept count of them all.
darkcraft.ayuda.arboleda: The Grove of the Hanged: go to one of its places, bring its Hanged Ones back (hanging again) or remove them
darkcraft.verdugo.voz.1: Another one for the tree... Kneel. The rope is waiting.
darkcraft.verdugo.voz.2: Up, my hanged ones! There is work to do!
darkcraft.verdugo.voz.4: Hold still... it is quicker that way.
darkcraft.verdugo.voz.5: The count... is closed. At last.
darkcraft.bestiario.verdugo.desc: Master Odran hanged whoever the law commanded and kept count of them all. When there was no one left to judge, he stayed with them. He waits on his gallows and leaps down with his axe first. His chop splits the earth; his sweep comes at waist height: you cannot jump it, roll. Whoever backs away gets his noose and, if it catches, is dragged to his feet to be executed. Wounded, he wakes his hanged ones.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.verdugo_hachazo: An axe bites into the earth
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.verdugo_barrido: A huge axe cleaves the air
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.verdugo_salto: The Hangman lands with a crash
advancements.darkcraft.verdugo.title: The Count Is Closed
advancements.darkcraft.verdugo.descripti: Defeat Master Odran, the Hangman of the Grove
darkcraft.diario.verdugo: The Grove's hangman was still on his gallows, leaning on his axe, keeping count. He leapt down and cast his noose the way a fisherman casts a net. When he fell, the hanged stopped creaking on their ropes: no one counts them anymore.
darkcraft.ayuda.verdugo: Master Odran, the Hangman: how he is, take you before the gallows, defeat him or bring him back
darkcraft.bestiario.podrido.desc: They drowned in the swamp and the Shadow swelled them with black water. They wait floating face down among the reeds, like one more log, and stand up when you pass close. Slow but stubborn: a swipe, a poisoned bite and, from a little further away, a gush of black water that poisons and leaves a puddle that slows.
darkcraft.bestiario.podrido_fatuo.desc: It carries one of the swamp's green lights, the ones that led the children into the water. It throws it from afar and, where it lands, a poisonous cloud lingers: do not stand still. Up close it strikes with it.
darkcraft.bestiario.podrido_hinchado.des: Its belly is about to burst, split open with gas seeping out. It throws itself onto whoever stands in front of it and belches a cloud that poisons and saps strength. When it dies, it bursts: get away.
advancements.darkcraft.podrido.title: Black Water
advancements.darkcraft.podrido.descripti: Defeat a Rotten One of the Rotting Marsh
advancements.darkcraft.pilotes.title: On the Stilts
darkcraft.diario.podrido: In the Rotting Marsh the drowned do not stay at the bottom: they float face down among the reeds and stand up when you pass. They smell of what they are.
darkcraft.diario.pilotes: The Stilt Village: huts over the lagoon, plank walkways and a half-sunken chapel. There are green lights among the reeds. I do not follow them.
darkcraft.ayuda.pilotes: The Stilt Village: go to one of its places, bring its Rotten Ones back or remove them
entity.darkcraft.barquero: The Ferryman of the Black Lagoon
darkcraft.barquero.voz.1: Another soul for the crossing... Pay the toll... or swim.
darkcraft.barquero.voz.2: Rise, my passengers! The boat is not yet full!
darkcraft.barquero.voz.3: The water always takes its due.
darkcraft.barquero.voz.5: The shore... at last... I can see the shore.
darkcraft.bestiario.barquero.desc: No one knows how long he has been crossing the lagoon. There is no one left to carry, yet he keeps rowing with his lantern raised and takes his toll from whoever comes near his landing. He leaps from his boat oar first; his oar slam raises a wave you dodge by jumping or rolling, and his sweep comes at waist height. He hooks whoever stands a few steps away with the oar's gaff and drags them to his feet to burn them with his lantern. When he raises it, soul fire spreads in a ring across the planks: jump over it. Wounded, he calls his passengers.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.barquero_grito: The Ferryman wails over the water
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.barquero_lintern: A lantern bursts into soul fire
advancements.darkcraft.barquero.title: The Last Crossing
advancements.darkcraft.barquero.descript: Defeat the Ferryman of the Black Lagoon
darkcraft.diario.barquero: The Ferryman of the Black Lagoon was still waiting in his boat, lantern raised. I paid his toll in steel. When he fell, his passengers stopped floating and the lanterns of the landing lit with true light. He said he could see the shore.
darkcraft.ayuda.laguna: The Black Lagoon: go to one of its places, bring its Rotten Ones back or remove them
darkcraft.ayuda.barquero: The Ferryman: how he is, take you to the landing, defeat him or bring him back
darkcraft.bestiario.helado_monje.desc: They kept praying at vespers while the cold crept into the church, and the Shadow woke them inside the ice. They wait on their knees, covered in frost, and break the ice when you come close. It swings its iron censer and, from a little further away, breathes out a freezing breath that chills and slows: do not stand in front of it. Fire hurts them more.
darkcraft.bestiario.helado_penitente.des: Bare-chested and crossed with chains, with ice crystals growing from its back. It wields a two-handed hammer of ice: when it brings it down, a row of ice spikes bursts out ahead, reaching further than the hammer; step aside. It also sweeps at waist height.
darkcraft.bestiario.helado_peregrino.des: They climbed waist-deep in snow to pray at the Frost and stayed on the road. Its staff bears an ice crystal at the tip: up close it strikes with it and, from afar, it hurls three shards that freeze and slow. Some still lie buried in the snow beside the road.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.helado_gemido: A Frozen One prays through the ice
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.helado_martillo: An ice hammer strikes the ground
advancements.darkcraft.helado.title: Breaking the Ice
advancements.darkcraft.helado.descriptio: Defeat a Frozen One of the Snowbound Mountains
advancements.darkcraft.monasterio.title: Endless Vespers
darkcraft.diario.helado: In the Snowbound Mountains the monks and the pilgrims froze as they prayed. They break the ice when you pass and their cold seeps into your bones. Fire brings them down sooner.
darkcraft.diario.monasterio: The Frostbound Monastery: a terrace cut into the slope, a cloister with a frozen fountain and a church where the monks are still kneeling in the pews. Now and then the bell tolls by itself.
darkcraft.ayuda.monasterio: The Frostbound Monastery: go to one of its places, bring its Frozen Ones back or remove them
darkcraft.abad.voz.1: You climbed to the summit... as I once did. Kneel, child. The cold will answer you too.
darkcraft.abad.voz.2: Brothers! Rise from the snow! Let the frost take them all!
darkcraft.abad.voz.3: Rest now. The cold forgives everything.
darkcraft.abad.voz.5: Warm... it is so warm... Forgive me, brothers.
darkcraft.bestiario.abad.desc: When the cold crept into the monastery, Abbot Hrodric climbed alone to the summit hermitage to pray for his brothers, and the Shadow answered him. Now he is a giant of ice who kneels in prayer before the hermitage. His crozier opens a row of ice spikes that reaches much further than he does: step aside. If you stand behind him or too close, he stomps and the spikes burst out in a ring. From afar he breathes a freezing gust that sweeps from side to side, and he raises his crozier to bring icicles down where you stand: get out of the mark on the ground. Wounded, he calls his brothers and raises a blizzard that freezes you to the bone: only the braziers of the calvary keep you warm. Fire hurts him more.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.abad_invocar: The Abbot calls on the sky
advancements.darkcraft.abad.title: The Last Toll
advancements.darkcraft.abad.description: Defeat Hrodric, Abbot of the Summit
darkcraft.diario.abad: At the top of the Penitents' Stair, Abbot Hrodric knelt in prayer before his hermitage, turned to ice. When he fell he shattered, and far below, in the monastery, the bell tolled one last time. The brothers still praying in the church are finally at rest. At the end he said he was warm.
darkcraft.ayuda.ermita: The Penitents' Stair and the hermitage: go to one of its places, bring its Frozen Ones back or remove them
darkcraft.ayuda.abad: The Abbot: how he is, take you before him, defeat him or bring him back
darkcraft.bestiario.calcinado_guardia.de: The Oath Guard shut the West Gate on the night of the red sky and stayed at their posts while the capital burned. Now they burn without burning away. They hide behind a tower shield: from the front almost nothing gets through, not even arrows; circle around them or wait for them to attack. Their red-hot sword leaves burns and the shield bash pushes and slows. Fire does nothing to them; ice and water, a great deal.
darkcraft.bestiario.calcinado_incendiari: Townsfolk of the capital who still keep pouring pitch on the fire. From afar they hurl pots of burning pitch that burst on the ground and leave a pool of flames: do not stand in it. Up close they strike with their torch. Do not give them distance.
darkcraft.bestiario.calcinado_ceniciento: What is left of those who never reached the gate: a body of ash that can barely stand. They lunge to grab you and hold on while they burn: the grab slows you greatly and burns. When they fall they burst into a blinding cloud of ash; step away before you finish them. Some wait buried in the heaps of ash.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.calcinado_gemido: A Charred One moans through embers
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.calcinado_muerte: A Charred One crumbles to ash
darkcraft.morvain.lugar.capital_puerta: The West Gate of the Capital
advancements.darkcraft.capital.title: No One Passes This Gate
advancements.darkcraft.capital.descripti: Pass through the West Gate of the Capital
advancements.darkcraft.calcinado.title: Embers Put Out
advancements.darkcraft.calcinado.descrip: Defeat a Charred One of the Capital
darkcraft.diario.calcinado: In the capital the people keep burning without burning away: the guards at their posts, the townsfolk with their pots of pitch and, turned to ash, those who never reached the gate. Fire does nothing to them; ice and water, a great deal.
darkcraft.diario.capital: The West Gate of the Capital: the broken wall, the burnt gate with its portcullis and, inside, the high street up to the square of the fallen statue and the barracks. The Oath Guard still keeps the wall-walk.
darkcraft.ayuda.capital: The West Gate of the Capital: go to one of its places, bring its Charred Ones back or remove them
entity.darkcraft.condestable: Ser Halvard, Constable of the Oath
darkcraft.condestable.voz.1: Halt! By order of the Constable, the gates are shut. No one enters... and no one leaves.
darkcraft.condestable.voz.2: Guard! To me! Hold the gate!
darkcraft.condestable.voz.5: Open... open the gates. Let them go home.
darkcraft.bestiario.condestable.desc: On the night of the red sky, Ser Halvard, Constable of the Oath, ordered every gate of the capital shut so the fire would not get out. The people burned in the streets and he stayed on one knee in the courtyard, burning inside his armour. His flaming greatsword sends fire along the ground in a line: step aside. He sweeps wide, charges from afar (dodge and let him crash into a wall) and, if you stand behind him or too close, he plants his sword and a ring of fire bursts out: jump over it. He raises his sword and pitch falls from the walls where you stand: get out of the mark. Wounded, he sounds his horn and the guard rises from the ash. He swore not to die: the first time he falls, he rises again with more fury. Fire does nothing to him; cold, a great deal.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.condestable_barr: A flaming greatsword cleaves the air
advancements.darkcraft.juramento.title: And No One Leaves
advancements.darkcraft.juramento.descrip: Enter the Courtyard of the Oath
advancements.darkcraft.condestable.title: Let Them Go Home
advancements.darkcraft.condestable.descr: Defeat Ser Halvard, Constable of the Oath
darkcraft.diario.juramento: East of the capital's square, the Courtyard of the Oath: the stone where the guard swore, the braziers still burning and, in the middle, a huge knight on one knee with his greatsword planted before him. When I walked in, the portcullis fell behind me.
darkcraft.diario.condestable: Ser Halvard, the Constable, swore not to die and kept his word once: he rose again, burning. When he fell for good he asked for the gates to be opened, and they opened: the portcullis of his courtyard, the gate of his tower and, at last, the West Gate. The guard that waited there is at rest.
darkcraft.ayuda.condestable: The Constable of the Oath: how he is, take you to his courtyard, defeat him, bring him back or raise the portcullis
darkcraft.bestiario.erudito_aprendiz.des: The Academy's apprentices did not leave their lesson on the night of the red sky: they keep reading without turning the page. They float, half see-through, and make no sound as they move. From afar they throw their inkwell, which bursts into a pool of ink that blinds and slows; up close, two stabs with the quill. Some wait lying among the books.
darkcraft.bestiario.erudito_maestro.desc: The masters do not come close. Their crystal staff releases an orb of light that follows you slowly (step aside or break it with a blow) and draws a circle of runes under your feet that bursts a moment later and throws you into the air: get out of it. If you rush them, they fade out and appear further away. Run at them when they finish casting.
darkcraft.bestiario.erudito_custodio.des: The custodians kept the Great Library and chained the tomes so that nothing would get out. Bigger and tougher, they slam their tome onto the floor (the shockwave reaches anyone standing nearby: jump or roll) and swing it on its chain, which reaches far and slows. Between blows they are slow to recover the tome.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.erudito_muerte: A scholar comes apart into pages
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.erudito_alzarse: A scholar rises among the books
advancements.darkcraft.academia.title: Silence in the Library
advancements.darkcraft.erudito.title: Class Dismissed
advancements.darkcraft.erudito.descripti: Defeat a scholar of the Academy
darkcraft.diario.academia: The Spectral Academy, on the limestone plateau: the white wall, the cloister with its amethyst fountain, the Great Library with its purple windows and, at the far end, the dais of the grimoire. The scholars are still at their posts, reading. To the northeast, the archive tower; to the east, far off, the observatory.
darkcraft.diario.erudito: The scholars of the Academy did not leave their lesson when the sky turned red. The apprentices throw their inkwells, the masters light runes under your feet and the custodians swing their chained tomes. They read without turning the page.
darkcraft.ayuda.academia: The Spectral Academy: go to one of its places, bring its scholars back or remove them
darkcraft.rectora.voz.1: Another reader? Come, then... the sky has written your name tonight.
darkcraft.rectora.voz.2: Masters! To your places! The lesson is not over.
darkcraft.rectora.voz.4: Read the stars... if you can.
darkcraft.rectora.voz.5: At last... the sky has stopped reading me.
darkcraft.bestiario.rectora.desc: On the night of the red sky, Ysolde, Rector of the Academy, climbed to the observatory to read the fire that fell. She said it was not fire but writing, and she never took her eye from the telescope. She floats before it, and the sky reads her. She sweeps her staff at whoever comes near and fades away if you get behind her; from afar she releases three orbs that follow you. She raises her staff and stars fall through the slit in the dome: get out of the circle of light. She plants stars in the floor around you and joins them with lines: when they ignite, standing on one burns. Wounded, she calls her masters to their lecterns. Magic does her half; fire, more.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.rectora_grito: The Rector screams with a thousand voices
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.rectora_baculo: A silver staff sweeps the air
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.observatorio_sel: A seal of light closes the door
advancements.darkcraft.observatorio.desc: Enter the rotunda of the Observatory
advancements.darkcraft.rectora.title: The Sky Stops Reading
advancements.darkcraft.rectora.descripti: Defeat Ysolde, Rector of the Academy
darkcraft.diario.observatorio: East of the academy, the observatory: a white rotunda with its copper dome open to the sky, the floor painted with stars and, at the far end, the great telescope. Before it floated the Rector, her hand raised to the stars. When I walked in, a seal of light closed the door.
darkcraft.diario.rectora: Ysolde, the Rector, read the sky until the sky read her. When she fell, she looked up one last time and came apart into stars that rose through the slit. The seal broke and her cell opened, and those who read in the academy at last turned the page.
darkcraft.ayuda.rectora: The Rector of the Academy: how she is, take you to her observatory, defeat her, bring her back or open the seal
darkcraft.bestiario.salobre_redero.desc: The fisherfolk of the Stranded Harbour went down onto the sand to gather what the sea had left, and the sea never came back. The salt ate them slowly. The netmender still mends his nets on his knees. Up close he swings the net's lead weight on its rope; from afar he throws the net: if it catches you, you are tangled and can barely move. Step aside when he draws it back.
darkcraft.bestiario.salobre_bichero.desc: The gaffer still watches a sea that is no longer there, with his iron-hooked pole. He reaches further than you: he drives the hook in and pulls, dragging you to him. If you get too close, he sweeps wide with the pole. Get inside his guard right after he pulls.
darkcraft.bestiario.salobre_salinero.des: The saltworkers were raking the salt pans when the sea left; salt covers their arms and beards. Bigger and tougher, they slam their rake into the ground and leave a crust of salt that slows whoever steps on it, and they throw a fistful of salt in your face, which stings and leaves you breathless. Some wait half-buried in the salt crust.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.salobre_rastrill: A rake slams into the salt
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.salobre_alzarse: A saltbound rises from the salt
advancements.darkcraft.puerto.title: Endless Low Tide
advancements.darkcraft.salobre.title: Shift's Over
advancements.darkcraft.salobre.descripti: Defeat a saltbound of the Stranded Harbour
advancements.darkcraft.faro.title: A Light for No One
advancements.darkcraft.faro.description: Climb to the top of the Lighthouse of Bones
darkcraft.diario.puerto: On the Coast of Bones, the Stranded Harbour: the sea drew back on the night of the red sky and left the bay dry, its boats lying on the sand beside the skeleton of a whale. Its people are still at work: they mend nets, rake salt and watch a sea that is no longer there.
darkcraft.diario.salobre: The saltbound were the harbour's fisherfolk and saltworkers, and the salt ate them. The netmenders tangle you in their nets, the gaffers drag you in with their hooks and the saltworkers leave crusts of salt on the ground and throw salt in your eyes.
darkcraft.diario.faro: I climbed the Lighthouse of Bones, a tower raised from whale bones, with its cold fire at the top. From the gallery you can see the whole dry bay and, far to the east, the line of the sea that left. To the north, the Ribcage.
darkcraft.ayuda.puerto: The Stranded Harbour: go to one of its places, bring its saltbound back or remove them
darkcraft.ballenero.voz.1: Another hand for the boats? Good... grab a line, lad. She's surfacing.
darkcraft.ballenero.voz.2: There she blows! THERE... SHE... BLOWS!
darkcraft.ballenero.voz.3: Overboard. The sea keeps what it takes.
darkcraft.ballenero.voz.4: Forty years I've hunted her... she won't slip me now.
darkcraft.ballenero.voz.5: The tide... d'you hear it? The tide's... coming back...
darkcraft.bestiario.ballenero.desc: Brann was the finest harpooner of the Stranded Harbour, and he spent forty years hunting the Old One, the white sperm whale that took his leg. On the night of the red sky he had her in range when the sea went, and he watched her sink into the sand as if the sand were the sea. Ever since, he keeps watch from the ribcage of another whale, harpoon and lantern in hand. He throws the harpoon on its line: if it sticks, he hauls on the rope and drags you to him; step aside when he draws his arm back. Up close he thrusts with the harpoon and slashes with his flensing knife, and he throws oil lanterns that leave the ground burning. When he cries "there she blows!", the Old One bursts out of the sand and charges along the ribs: watch where the spout rises and get out of her way. At half health he leaps on his peg leg, shaking the ground, and calls the Old One again and again.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.ballenero_arpon: A harpoon whistles out on its line
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.ballenero_vieja: The Old One blows beneath the sand
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.ballenero_espera: The ropes of the ribcage creak
advancements.darkcraft.costillar.title: Beneath the Ribs
advancements.darkcraft.ballenero.title: The Tide Comes Back
darkcraft.diario.costillar: North of the Stranded Harbour, the Whale's Ribcage: the skeleton of a huge whale stranded on the sand, its ribs as tall as church arches and its skull open to the east. Among the bones, the tryworks, an overturned boat and the harpoons driven into the ground. Beneath the ribs an old man with a peg leg waited on his knees, looking out at the sea that is no longer there.
darkcraft.diario.ballenero: Brann the Whaler spent forty years hunting the Old One. When he cried out, she burst from the sand, white and hollow as a memory, and charged between the ribs. When he fell, kneeling on his harpoon, the Old One surfaced one last time and rose into the sky, and the saltbound of the harbour at last let go of their nets.
darkcraft.ayuda.ballenero: The Whaler of the Coast of Bones: how he is, take you to his ribcage, defeat him or bring him back
darkcraft.bestiario.penitente_flagelante: The pilgrims went to the crater to beg forgiveness, and on the night of the red sky something answered them. The flagellant, in blood red with his back flayed raw, prays on his knees as he scourges himself. He strikes with his scourge, and every lash leaves you bleeding: if the blood builds up, it bursts into a haemorrhage that takes a great deal of health at once. Back away and let it pass. When wounded he lashes himself into a frenzy, and then he hits harder and runs faster.
darkcraft.bestiario.penitente_portador.d: The cross-bearer, in black and bigger than the rest, drags a wooden cross that no one helps him carry anymore. He slams it into the ground and the shockwave knocks down anyone standing nearby: jump or roll. He sweeps it from side to side and, if you back away, charges with the cross held before him like a ram. The cross-bearers kneel in prayer beside the float they left on the road.
darkcraft.bestiario.penitente_turiferari: The thurifer, in purple and gold, swings his brass censer: it burns whoever it reaches. He breathes out clouds of blood incense that make whoever stays inside bleed and slow them down, and that shelter the penitents. When his brethren are wounded he intones a chant that heals them and hardens them: go for him first.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.penitente_cruz: A cross slams into the ground
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.penitente_arrast: A cross drags along the ground
subtitles.darkcraft.ambiente.sinfe: Wind blows over the cracked earth
advancements.darkcraft.grieta.title: Over the Abyss
advancements.darkcraft.grieta.descriptio: Cross the Bridge of the Rift
advancements.darkcraft.penitente.title: No Absolution
advancements.darkcraft.penitente.descrip: Defeat a penitent of the Faithless Land
darkcraft.diario.grieta: In the Faithless Land, the Rift: a chasm that drops all the way down to the blood, and over it a bridge of black stone with its bell. To the south, the pilgrims' hostel and the penitents' camp; to the north, the gate towards the crater, a float abandoned in the middle of the road and the graveyard of those who never arrived. They say you should not ring the bell.
darkcraft.diario.penitente: The penitents were the pilgrims who went to the crater to beg forgiveness. Now they pray, scourge themselves and bleed. The flagellants make you bleed with their scourges, the cross-bearers strike the ground with their crosses and the thurifers wrap you in blood incense and heal their brethren with their chant.
darkcraft.ayuda.grieta: The Bridge of the Rift: go to one of its places, ring the bell, bring its penitents back or remove them
darkcraft.pontifice.voz.1: Kneel, my child. The altar is thirsty... and you are still so full.
darkcraft.pontifice.voz.2: Do you see? I give mine as well. Rise, my brothers... rise, and walk with me!
darkcraft.pontifice.voz.4: Your blood is a prayer... and I hear it.
darkcraft.pontifice.voz.5: Forgive me... I only wanted... someone to answer.
darkcraft.bestiario.pontifice.desc: Anselm was the bishop who led the pilgrims to the crater to beg forgiveness. On the night of the red sky something answered him, and he took it as a command: that they should give their blood. He named himself Pontiff and led them to the Altar of Blood, and there he remains, on his knees, with the chalice full. He strikes with his three-barred ferula, which cuts and makes you bleed, and flings the blood of the chalice in a fan: get away from his front when he draws his arm back. If he sees you bleeding he raises the chalice, and your blood flies to him and heals him: do not come close with an open wound. When he drives the ferula down, a mark appears beneath your feet and a moment later a column of blood: move. At half health he pours the chalice over his own head: from then on he bleeds wherever he treads, moves faster, and the procession rises from the channels of the nave.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.pontifice_golpe: The ferula's cross strikes the stone
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.pontifice_uncion: The Pontiff pours the chalice over himself
advancements.darkcraft.altar.title: The Altar Is Thirsty
advancements.darkcraft.altar.description: Enter the basilica of the Desecrated Altar
advancements.darkcraft.pontifice.title: No More Blood
darkcraft.diario.altar: Northwest of the rifts, where the earth is reddest, the Desecrated Altar: a roofless basilica with its bell tower half fallen. A channel of blood runs down the nave from the fonts of the crossing, and at the far end, before the altar of blood and its broken cross, a towering old man prayed on his knees, his tiara on and his chalice full.
darkcraft.diario.pontifice: Anselm, the Bleeding Pontiff, believed that the voice of the crater asked for blood in exchange for forgiveness. He drank the blood of whoever bled near him, and when he poured the chalice over his head the procession rose from the blood of the nave. When he fell, the chalice slipped from his hands, and all across the Faithless Land the penitents at last stopped praying.
darkcraft.ayuda.pontifice: The Pontiff of the Desecrated Altar: how he is, take you to his basilica, defeat him or bring him back
darkcraft.bestiario.marcado_rompedor.des: Before you, the Shadow pulled others out of death and set its mark on them so they would break its chains. They could not. The breaker, bare under his smith's apron and with the mark branded on his brow, still strikes the anchor with his maul. He raises the maul above his head and smashes it down: the shockwave knocks down anyone standing nearby, so jump or roll. He also sweeps to the sides. Once wounded, the mark burns on him: then his shadow repeats every blow a moment later, where he struck.
darkcraft.bestiario.marcado_caballero.de: The marked knight wears black armour with the mark on his breastplate and a shield with the eye painted on it. He guards from the front: the shield stops almost everything and arrows entirely; find his back or strike him while he attacks. He slashes, lunges in from afar with his thrust, and his shield bash leaves you out of breath. Once wounded, his shadow repeats every blow: do not stay where he has just struck.
darkcraft.bestiario.marcado_cazador.desc: The marked hunter, with his hood and the scarf that hides his face, shoots from the tops of the towers and from afar. His black arrow is slow to come, but whoever it reaches has their sight clouded and is weakened: step aside when he draws it. If you get close, he dissolves into shadow and reappears a few blocks away, or stabs you with the arrow in his hand. Once wounded, his shadow repeats every shot.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.marcado_muerte: A Marked One dissolves into shadow
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.marcado_mazazo: A maul smashes into the ground
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.marcado_desliz: A Marked One dissolves into shadow
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.marcado_esfuerzo: A Marked One raises his maul
advancements.darkcraft.cerco.title: At the Foot of the Chain
advancements.darkcraft.marcado.title: What You Could Have Been
advancements.darkcraft.marcado.descripti: Defeat a Marked One of the Crater of Blood
darkcraft.diario.cerco: On the slope of the Crater of Blood, at the foot of the southern anchor, the one whose chain rises to the citadel: the Anchor's Ring, a round wall of black stone with pulsing runes. Inside, the ground around the anchor is broken by blows, and there is a forge, a camp and the hut of the first one who came. From the shrine a road comes down between steles and hanging cages.
darkcraft.diario.marcado: The Marked Ones are those the Shadow brought back before me, with the same mark and the same promise: break my chains and you shall rest. They are still striking the anchor. The breakers smash down their mauls, the knights guard behind their shields and the hunters shoot black arrows from the towers. When the mark burns on them, their shadow repeats every blow.
darkcraft.ayuda.cerco: The Anchor's Ring: go to one of its places, bring its Marked Ones back or remove them
darkcraft.aldric.voz.1: Another one... with the mark. Go back down, child. There is no rest up there.
darkcraft.aldric.voz.2: I climbed it too! I saw what waits at the top... I will not let it have you!
darkcraft.aldric.voz.3: Rest now. Better here... than up there.
darkcraft.aldric.voz.4: The chain holds everything it touches.
darkcraft.aldric.voz.5: Go, then... climb. And when it opens its mouth... do not answer.
darkcraft.bestiario.aldric.desc: Aldric was the first one the Shadow pulled out of death and marked: break my chains and you shall rest. He struck the southern chain for a thousand winters, until he climbed it and saw what waits in the citadel. He came down, and since then he prays atop the anchor and lets no one who bears the mark climb. When he sees you he rises and roars: the Marked Ones of the ring kneel, the chain closes the gate and he leaps down on you from above. He strikes with the broken chain wound around his arm: the chain sweep clears everything in front of him, the lash reaches you from afar and drags you to him, the star smashes the ground (jump or roll) and the whirlwind strikes twice all around: get away when he stretches out his arm. At half health his mark burns: from then on his reflection repeats every chain strike a moment later, and when he punches the ground a mark appears beneath your feet and chains burst out a moment later to hold you: move.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.aldric_cadenazo: A heavy chain sweeps the air
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.aldric_latigazo: A chain cracks like a whip
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.aldric_salto: Something huge falls from the sky
advancements.darkcraft.aldric.title: The First One
darkcraft.diario.aldric: Aldric, the First Marked, was the first to wake with the mark. He climbed the southern chain until he saw the citadel up close, and came down so that no one else would climb. When he roared, the Marked Ones of the ring knelt, and the chain wound around his arm struck like a battering ram. As he fell he looked up at the citadel and told me to climb... and not to answer when that thing opens its mouth. The southern chain has no guardian any more.
darkcraft.ayuda.aldric: Aldric, the First Marked: how he is, take you to his ring, defeat him, bring him back or break the chain on the gate
darkcraft.gigante.voz.1: Little one... you should not be here. The bell... rings for you.
darkcraft.gigante.voz.2: Every toll... is a name... a name I could not save!
darkcraft.gigante.voz.3: Ring it... for me, little one. Ring it... once.
darkcraft.gigante.voz.4: These bones... were my brothers. And you... walk on them.
darkcraft.gigante.voz.5: The Shadow took them all... You will not take the last!
darkcraft.gigante.voz.6: Lay me... with them. By the sea... by the sea.
darkcraft.gigante.voz.7: I raised these walls... stone by stone. Nothing... comes in.
darkcraft.gigante.voz.8: The king is gone! The city is gone! But the stone... REMEMBERS!
darkcraft.bestiario.gigante_campana.desc: Ogmund rang the bell of a village of the Pale Plains that no longer exists. When the Shadow took his people, he tore the bell from its tower, lashed it to the end of a beam and started walking. Ever since, he wanders the southern roads and tolls for every name he remembers. He strikes with the bell: he raises it in both hands and smashes it down in front of him; whoever gets between his feet, he stomps. Hit him hard enough in a short time and he falls to one knee.
darkcraft.bestiario.gigante_costilla.des: Ulfgar is the last of the giants of the coast. The others fell on the shore of the Dead Sea and their ribs are still there, white, driven into the sand. He carries one as a weapon and walks among them without rest, guarding them. He sweeps the ground with the rib, and whoever keeps away he pelts with boulders torn from the earth. Hit him hard enough in a short time and he falls to one knee.
darkcraft.bestiario.gigante_columna.desc: Haldor was the king's mason: he raised the walls of the Capital stone by stone. The city fell and he was left outside, circling what remains of it with a marble column on his shoulder. The stone dust has seeped into his skin and he is slowly turning to stone. His column crushes whatever it reaches and its shockwave knocks down anyone standing. Hit him hard enough in a short time and he falls to one knee.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.gigante_arranca: A giant tears a boulder from the ground
darkcraft.diario.gigante_campana: Ogmund of the Bell has fallen on the Pale Plains. Before he fell he asked me to ring his bell once, for him. The bell has stayed where he fell, with its beam.
darkcraft.diario.gigante_costilla: Ulfgar of the Ribs has fallen on the Coast of Bones, among his brothers' ribs. He wanted to rest with them, by the sea. His rib has stayed driven into the ground where he fell.
darkcraft.diario.gigante_columna: Haldor of the Column has fallen beside the Capital he walled himself. He asked me to build something better. His column lies where he fell.
darkcraft.diario.campana_ogmund: I rang Ogmund's bell. It sounded across the whole of the Plains, once, as he wished.
darkcraft.ayuda.gigante: The wandering giants of Morvain: how they are, take you to one, bring one out in front of you, defeat it, knock it to one knee or bring it back
darkcraft.jinete.voz.1: Who rides the King's road by night? Stand aside, stranger... or fall beneath my hooves.
darkcraft.jinete.voz.2: I carry the King's word! Nothing... stops the King's word!
darkcraft.jinete.voz.3: Dawn again... and the stair is still so far.
darkcraft.jinete.voz.4: For the King! Clear the road!
darkcraft.jinete.voz.5: The letter... take it to the fortress. Tell them... I rode every night. Every night.
darkcraft.bestiario.jinete.desc: Ser Lucan was King Corvin's herald. On the night the kingdom rose into the sky he left the Ascent Tower with the King's last letter for the Bone Fortress, and something caught him on the road. Ever since, every night, he rises from the mist and rides the cloud road towards the fortress, and at dawn he fades away without ever reaching the stair. Whoever crosses his path hears his horn, which chills the blood and slows you down. From afar he lowers his glaive like a lance and charges at a gallop: get out of his line to the side, rolling or jumping. Up close he slashes from the saddle, swings the glaive all the way around if you get behind him, and his horse rears and crashes down with its forelegs. Whatever he knocks down he pushes along the road, never off it; but whoever steps off the stones falls into the void. At half health he leaves blue flames wherever he gallops. Hit him hard enough in a short time and the horse stumbles and falls to its knees. Fire does nothing to him.
advancements.darkcraft.jinete.title: Every Night
advancements.darkcraft.jinete.descriptio: Defeat Ser Lucan, the Night Rider
darkcraft.diario.jinete: Ser Lucan, the Night Rider, was King Corvin's herald. One night he set out along the cloud road with the King's last letter for the Bone Fortress and never arrived: ever since he rode every night, and the dawn undid him before he could see the stair. As he fell he gave me the letter. He asked me to carry it to the fortress... and to tell them he rode every night.
darkcraft.ayuda.jinete: Ser Lucan, the Night Rider: how he is, take you in front of him, bring him here, defeat him, make him stumble, bring him back, or make it night or day
darkcraft.bufon.voz.1: Oh! An audience! No one has come to see me in a thousand years... Will you laugh for Pell?
darkcraft.bufon.voz.2: Which one is Pell? Which one is real? Even I forgot, long ago!
darkcraft.bufon.voz.3: The King laughed at all my jokes... until the night the sky turned red.
darkcraft.bufon.voz.5: Bravo... bravo... The last act... and no one... applauds.
darkcraft.bestiario.bufon.desc: Pell made the last king of Morvain laugh. On the night the sky turned red he was on stage, in the middle of the show: everyone ran, they bricked up the royal door with him behind it, and he kept on performing. A thousand years later he is still waiting for an audience in the Hall of Masks, beneath the stage of the Sunken Theater. He fights hopping about: the double slash with his two daggers, the pirouette that cuts everything around him, three knives thrown from afar one after another, and his juggling, three fireballs lobbed in an arc that burst into flames. He smashes a smoke bomb that blinds and leaps out behind you; if you hit him again and again, he backflips away (nothing touches him while he spins) and throws knives at you. At half health he splits in three: two illusions just like him fight at his side and vanish with a single blow; hitting the real one undoes whatever is left. The illusions shimmer a little and cast no shadow.
darkcraft.morvain.muro_ilusorio: The wall was nothing but an illusion
advancements.darkcraft.teatro.title: The Court Theater
advancements.darkcraft.teatro.descriptio: Go down into the Sunken Theater
advancements.darkcraft.bufon.title: The Last Performance
darkcraft.diario.teatro: East of the Capital, sunk into the plain, lies the court theater: ten rows of white stone going down to a round orchestra and, at the back, the stage wall with its columns, two masks —one laughing, one weeping— and the king's crown above the royal door, which has been bricked up. The footlights are still burning. Sometimes, behind the wall, someone can be heard laughing.
darkcraft.diario.bufon: Pell, the jester of the last king of Morvain, performed alone beneath the stage for a thousand years, waiting for someone to come and see him. He laughed, split himself in three and threw knives and fireballs at me. As he fell he asked me for the applause no one ever gave him. When his laughter died away, the empty theater applauded.
darkcraft.ayuda.teatro: The Sunken Theater: go to one of its places, its burned ones, or open and close its illusory walls
darkcraft.ayuda.bufon: Pell, the King's Jester: how he is, take you to his hall, defeat him, bring him back or make him split in three
darkcraft.dragon.voz.1: Another little spark of the Shadow... climbing my mountain. I have burned kings for less.
darkcraft.dragon.voz.2: You dare wound me? I was old when your Shadow was a whisper in the dark!
darkcraft.dragon.voz.5: The sky... the sky was mine... before it turned red...
darkcraft.bestiario.dragon.desc: For centuries Vorthak guarded the passes of the Snowy Mountains for the kings of Morvain, in exchange for a cartload of gold every winter. On the night of the red sky he went mad: he burned the Raven's Watchtower with its garrison inside, and ever since he has slept on the gold of those who climb up to kill him, on a ledge of the mountain. He sleeps with one eye open: do not walk up to him on your feet (crouching you can get much closer) and do not touch his gold. On the ground he bites whatever is in front of him, sweeps with his claw, lashes with his tail at anyone who gets behind him, knocks everyone down with the wind of his wings, rears up and slams down with his forelegs (jump to escape the shockwave) and breathes fire in a cone from his right to his left: it does not reach behind a boulder. Every so often he takes to the air: he strafes low, burning the ground in a line, hovers spitting fireballs, or dives down where the ground is marked. At half health he rains embers on the ledge (they do not reach under a roof) and his breath leaves the ground burning. Hit him hard enough in a short time and he falls on his side, in the air too: from afar. Fire does nothing to him.
advancements.darkcraft.nido.title: The Ash Nest
advancements.darkcraft.nido.description: Climb up to the dragon's ledge in the Snowy Mountains
advancements.darkcraft.dragon.title: Ashes to Ashes
darkcraft.diario.nido: High in the Snowy Mountains, the path from the shrine climbs to an open ledge on the mountainside: the ground is black and scorched, full of bones and broken spears, and at the back a heap of gold glitters. On the edge stands what is left of the Raven's Watchtower, half fallen and black with soot. A dragon sleeps on the gold. It breathes slowly, and smoke rises from its nostrils.
darkcraft.diario.dragon: Vorthak, the Ash Dragon, guarded the mountain passes for the kings of Morvain, until the sky turned red and something burned inside him. He burned the ground under my feet, spat fire at me from the sky and hurled himself down on me. As he fell he looked up and said the sky had been his, before it turned red. The embers in his scales went out one by one.
darkcraft.ayuda.nido: The Ash Nest: go to one of its places, or its burned ones
darkcraft.ayuda.dragon: Vorthak, the Ash Dragon: how he is, take you to his ledge, defeat him, bring him back, half health, or make him attack now (take off, strafe, fireballs, dive, embers, land, knock down)
darkcraft.bestiario.gargola.desc: The gargoyles guard the southern chain for the Shadow. They wait on their knees on the pedestals of the landings, as still as the stone they are made of (crouching, you can pass closer), or circle in the air above the walkway. When they wake their stone cracks and their eyes light up. In the air they fly around their prey, above and to one side, and every so often they attack: they stop, shriek and dive at your chest (it knocks you aside: off the chain if you do not crouch or roll), hover in front of you and lash out with their claws, or land on the walkway. On the ground they strike twice with their claws and sweep their tail all the way around, and after two or three blows they take to the air again. When they hover or land, that is the moment to hit them. When they die they break to pieces.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.21: Yes... climb, marked one. Every link brings you closer to me.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.22: The first one rested here too... and then he ran. Will you run?
darkcraft.sombra.voz.23: There is no door, marked one... only my mouth. Come in.
darkcraft.corcel.cadena: The steed will not climb the chain

advancements.darkcraft.descansillo.descr: Reach the Landing, the camp of those who climbed
advancements.darkcraft.gargola.title: Stone That Flies
advancements.darkcraft.gargola.descripti: Defeat a gargoyle of the chain

advancements.darkcraft.boca.description: Enter the Maw of the citadel
advancements.darkcraft.ciudadela.title: The Chained Citadel
advancements.darkcraft.ciudadela.descrip: Reach the courtyard of the citadel in the sky
darkcraft.diario.cadena: From the top of the anchor, where Aldric used to pray, a walkway of planks climbs along the top of the southern chain up to the citadel in the sky. Planks are missing here and there and the railing has fallen in many places. Below there is only the crater, very far down. Now and then the wind blows from the side: you can hear it coming.
darkcraft.diario.descansillo: Halfway up the chain is the Landing: a large platform with a shrine, a plank hut and the bedrolls of those who climbed with Aldric. No one is left. On the lectern in the hut there is a diary. It says Aldric climbed alone to the top and came back down running.
darkcraft.diario.gargola: On the pedestals of the landings there are stone gargoyles. They are not statues: when I came close their stone cracked, they shrieked and took to the air. They circle around and dive at your chest. Crouching I can take the blow; standing, they knock me off the chain.
darkcraft.diario.boca: At the top, where the chain enters the island, the rock opens into a mouth with stone teeth, and above it there are two red eyes. Inside there is a red throat that breathes and beats. The Shadow says there is no door: only her mouth.
darkcraft.diario.ciudadela: The throat climbs a flight of steps to the ground floor of a tower in the wall, and its door opens onto the courtyard of the citadel. I am inside the island that hangs from the eight chains, above the Shadow's crag. The keep stands ahead, with its red windows.
darkcraft.ayuda.cadena: The southern chain: go to one of its places, its marked ones and gargoyles, a gust now, make the Shadow speak again or what the nearest gargoyle is doing
darkcraft.isolde.voz.1: Corvin...? Is that you at the door? No... Corvin is dead. You killed him for me. How kind.
darkcraft.isolde.voz.3: You want to see my face? He never wanted to see it either.
darkcraft.isolde.voz.4: Hush now... the Shadow will wake you again.
darkcraft.isolde.voz.6: Corvin... I can hear the fountain again... It was never me.
darkcraft.isolde.dormido: Your eyes close... (do not look at her while she sings)
darkcraft.sombra.voz.24: Welcome to my house, marked one. Mind my guards... they never learned how to die.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.15: You climbed the chain and walked through the Shadow's own house... I lit this fire long ago, for whoever came this far. I had almost stopped hoping.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.16: Above us sits the thing that wears Queen Isolde's face. Above her, the Shadow waits. Rest first. This fire will be here when you come back.
darkcraft.bestiario.centinela_espadon.de: The suits of armor of the citadel guard are still on duty, though no one is left inside: the Shadow kept what was inside and left them the smoke. They wait as still as any other armor, or lie in a heap of iron, and wake when you pass close by (crouching, closer). The greatsword sentinel swings from side to side and brings its blade down so hard the floor shakes: jump or roll. From afar it dissolves into smoke, crosses over to you and comes out of it with a thrust. When it dies it collapses and the smoke escapes.
darkcraft.bestiario.centinela_alabarda.d: An empty suit of armor of the citadel guard, with its halberd. Its thrust reaches very far, it chops, and if you get beside or behind it, it sweeps all the way around. Like every sentinel, from afar it dissolves into smoke and appears right in front of you. They never learned how to die: you have to bring them down one by one.
darkcraft.bestiario.isolde.desc: What the Shadow gave back when King Corvin begged for his queen: it has her face, her voice and her crown, but it is not her. It waits seated on the citadel's throne, humming. It slashes with its claws, spins with its veil, lunges with open arms (if it catches you, it holds you tight and drains your life) and fades away to appear at your back. When it sings its lullaby, do not look at it: whoever watches it sing has their eyes closed. At half health its veil burns and you can see its face: from then on the veil burns, it weeps black tears that fall where you stand, and it calls its court.
darkcraft.homenaje.sello: The throne room is sealed while the queen fights
darkcraft.homenaje.reja: The gate will not move: something holds it from the throne
darkcraft.homenaje.aguja: The door of the spire is sealed. Not yet.
advancements.darkcraft.homenaje.title: The Shadow's House
advancements.darkcraft.homenaje.descript: Enter the keep of the citadel
advancements.darkcraft.centinela.title: They Never Learned How to Die
advancements.darkcraft.centinela.descrip: Bring down a sentinel of the citadel
advancements.darkcraft.ultima_llama.desc: Reach the last shrine, in the black chapel of the keep
advancements.darkcraft.isolde.title: It Was Never Her
darkcraft.diario.homenaje: The portcullis of the keep rose by itself when I reached the door, as if they were expecting me. Inside, a hall with suits of armor on both sides of the carpet. The Shadow welcomed me to the house and warned me about the guard. The stairs run along the walls, each one on the opposite side of the hall.
darkcraft.diario.centinela: The suits of armor in the hall are not entirely empty: there is smoke inside them and two embers behind the helm. They wake when you pass close, dissolve into smoke and appear right in front of you. When they fall, they collapse and the smoke escapes. They never learned how to die.
darkcraft.diario.ultima_llama: In the black chapel, above the prison, there is a lit shrine: the Last Flame. Maelis was there, sitting by the fire. She says she lit it long ago, for whoever made it this far. The throne room is above.
darkcraft.diario.isolde: Queen Isolde was waiting on her throne, humming. She called me Corvin and then thanked me for killing him. When she sang I had to turn my back on her; when her veil burned I saw her face. As she fell, kneeling in the air, she said she could hear the fountain again. That it was never her. The gate to the roof stairs opened.
darkcraft.ayuda.homenaje: The keep: go to one of its places, its sentinels and the rest of the house, the gate's portcullis or make the Shadow speak again on entering
darkcraft.ayuda.isolde: Queen Isolde: how she is, take you before her, defeat her, bring her back, half health or make her attack now (claws, veil, embrace, lullaby, fade, tears, her court)
darkcraft.sombra.voz.25: There it is... the door I could never open. Put your hand on it, marked one. Let me out.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.26: A thousand winters. Kings... knights... queens... every marked one I dragged back from the dark. All of it, to bring you here. Now... come closer. Let me wear your face.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.27: Enough! You are MINE. I dragged you out of the dark... and I can drag you back.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.28: Get up, marked one. Death is mine... and I am not finished with you.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.29: Rise... all of you who failed me.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.30: Wait... wait, marked one. Take my heart. Wear my crown... and death will never touch you again. Or strike... and go back to dying like all the rest. Answer me.
darkcraft.sombra.voz.31: No... I waited... I always waited... so cold...
darkcraft.sombra.voz.32: Yes... Now you will wait... as I waited.
darkcraft.dialogo.sombra.30: Wait... wait, marked one. Take my heart. Wear my crown... and death will never touch you again. Or strike... and go back to dying like all the rest. Answer me.
darkcraft.bestiario.sombra.desc: What has waited in chains at the top of the citadel for a thousand winters: the Shadow that drags the dead out of the dark and puts its mark on them. It has no face: inside its hood there is only darkness and red eyes, and above it floats Corvin's broken crown. It claws, spins with its arms spread wide, hurls the chain from its wrist to drag you in, makes hands rise from the floor beneath your feet (do not stand still), throws shadow spears and dissolves into mist to appear at your back. At half health it breaks its last chain: its gaze sweeps the hall (close to it, the beam passes overhead), its scream pushes you away and darkens everything, and it calls the marked ones who failed it. It does not die: it yields and offers you its heart.
darkcraft.aguja.no_cede: The door will not yield: something holds it from the throne below
darkcraft.aviso.puerta_aguja: to put your hand on the door
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.sombra_mirada: A red beam sweeps the hall
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.corazon_toma: A heart beats in your chest
advancements.darkcraft.aguja.title: The Heart of the Spire
advancements.darkcraft.aguja.description: Open the door of the spire and enter where the Shadow waits
advancements.darkcraft.sombra.title: The Nameless Shadow
advancements.darkcraft.alba.title: The First Dawn
darkcraft.diario.aguja: On the roof stood the door of the spire: a seal of weeping stone with red gems. The Shadow asked me to put my hand on it and let it out. I did. Inside, in a round hall with its mark on the floor, it hung from its chains between six pillars, with Corvin's broken crown floating above its hood.
darkcraft.diario.sombra: The Shadow broke its chains and fought: claws, chains, hands rising from the floor, shadow spears. At half its strength it broke the last chain, more eyes opened in its hood and it called the marked ones who had failed it. In the end it fell to its knees in the air and offered me its heart.
darkcraft.diario.alba: I struck its heart. The Shadow said it had always waited, that it was cold, and it came apart. The red began to leave the clouds.
darkcraft.diario.nueva_sombra: I took its heart. It beats in my chest, cold. The Shadow said: "Now you will wait... as I waited." And it came apart.
darkcraft.ayuda.aguja: The spire: how it is, go before its door, open it now, close it or make the Shadow say its spire lines to you again
darkcraft.ayuda.sombra: The Nameless Shadow: how it is, take you to its hall, make it yield now, bring it back (forgetting everything), half health, answer now (strike or take its heart) or make it attack now
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.17: The red is leaving the clouds... Do you see it, marked one? The first dawn in a thousand winters.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.18: The fires are going out, one by one. My sisters can rest at last... and so can I.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.19: Your mark is fading. The next time you fall... you may not rise again. Live as if that were true.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.20: Thank you... for not answering it.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.21: The clouds are grey again... but the fires know what you did. They burn cold now.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.22: You took its heart. Its hunger will wake in you, slowly... and one day you will call it your own.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.23: Someday another marked one will climb the chain... and you will be waiting. You always wait.
darkcraft.creditos.frase.alba: And the red left the clouds.
darkcraft.creditos.frase.sombra: And someone waits in the spire once more.

advancements.darkcraft.epilogo.title: What Remains
advancements.darkcraft.epilogo.descripti: Listen to Maelis when it is all over
darkcraft.diario.epilogo_alba: I woke beside the Last Flame. Maelis was waiting for me. She said the fires are going out one by one and that her sisters can rest at last, and so can she. That my mark is fading: the next time I fall I may not rise. She thanked me for not answering it.
darkcraft.diario.epilogo_sombra: I woke beside the Last Flame. Maelis would not look at me. She said the Shadow's hunger will wake in me, slowly, and that one day I will call it my own. That someday another marked one will climb the chain... and I will be waiting. The shrine fires no longer give any warmth.
darkcraft.ayuda.final: The ending: how it is, watch the dawn or the new Shadow cinematic (with its credits and Maelis), the credits, Maelis's epilogue, see it all again or remove the ending from the world
